{{2023–24 WAC men's basketball standings}}
The '''2023–24 California Baptist Lancers men's basketball team''' represented [[California Baptist University]] in the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by eleventh-year head coach [[Rick Croy]] and played their games at [[Fowler Events Center]] in [[Riverside, California]] as members of the [[Western Athletic Conference]] (WAC). They finished the season 16–17, 8–12 in [[2023–24 Western Athletic Conference men's basketball season|WAC play]], to finish in eighth place. As the No. 8 seed in the WAC tournament, they defeated [[2023–24 Utah Valley Wolverines men's basketball team|Utah Valley]] in the first round,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Collom |first=Ryley |date=2024-03-13 |title=The Lancers Advance to the WAC Quarterfinals after Dominating Utah Valley in Overtime |url=https://cbulancers.com/news/2024/3/14/mens-basketball-the-lancers-advance-to-the-wac-quarterfinals-after-dominating-utah-valley-in-overtime.aspx |access-date=2024-09-29 |website=CBU Athletics |language=en}}</ref> before losing to [[2023–24 Seattle Redhawks men's basketball team|Seattle]] in the quarterfinals.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Collom |first=Ryley |date=2024-03-14 |title=The 2023-24 Season Ends in the WAC Quarterfinals |url=https://cbulancers.com/news/2024/3/14/mens-basketball-the-2023-24-season-ends-in-the-wac-quarterfinals.aspx |access-date=2024-09-29 |website=CBU Athletics |language=en}}</ref>

== Previous season ==
The [[2022–23 California Baptist Lancers men's basketball team|Lancers]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 17–16, 8–10 in WAC play, to finish in eighth place. In the [[2023 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]], the team won their first-round game against [[2022–23 Abilene Christian Wildcats men's basketball team|Abilene Christian]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Collom |first=Ryley |date=2023-03-07 |title=Tre Armstrong's Shooting Fuels CBU's Opening Round Win over ACU |url=https://cbulancers.com/news/2023/3/7/mens-basketball-tre-armstrongs-shooting-fuels-cbus-opening-round-win-over-acu.aspx |access-date=2024-09-29 |website=CBU Athletics |language=en}}</ref> before falling in the quarterfinals to [[2022–23 Sam Houston Bearkats men's basketball team|Sam Houston]] to end their season.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Collom |first=Ryley |date=2023-03-09 |title=The Season Ends in WAC Quarterfinals for Men's Basketball |url=https://cbulancers.com/news/2023/3/9/the-season-ends-in-wac-quarterfinals-for-mens-basketball.aspx |access-date=2024-09-29 |website=CBU Athletics |language=en}}</ref>
